raw_response:
I am old now, and with only 5 mu and some family labor working off-farm, I will keep my plan simple, familiar, and low-risk. I will put most of my land into the wheat-maize rotation because that is the steadiest way for me to secure grain and use my well water well. I will keep a smaller piece for cotton, because I have grown it for many years and I still want some cash income, but I will not expand it because cotton needs more picking and field watching. I will use better seed where it helps me most, especially for maize and wheat, because on small land I care more about stable yield than saving a little seed money. I will not push fertilizer too hard; I will use enough for steady production, with wheat taking more fertilizer and water, maize using medium input, and cotton managed more cautiously. For tillage, I will mostly use rotary tillage because it is easier and saves labor for my age.
